event.title: Gadi Eisenkot Emerges as Frontrunner to Form Israeli Government
event.canonical_title: Gadi Eisenkot Emerges as Frontrunner to Form Israeli Government
event.summary: Gadi Eisenkot has become the leading candidate to form a new government in Israel following a coalition deadlock. His rise comes after a key ultra-Orthodox party declined to recommend any candidate, leading to increased support for Eisenkot from various political factions, including Arab parties. Israeli President Isaac Herzog is expected to announce his decision on the matter soon.

timeline.title: Momentum Builds for Coalition Talks in Israel as Eisenkot Gains Support
timeline.summary: Following inconclusive elections, opposition candidate Gadi Eisenkot is gaining momentum in his efforts to form a government in Israel. He has received significant backing, including from Arab parties, as President Isaac Herzog prepares to announce who will be tasked with forming the new government. Eisenkot aims to replace long-serving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
key_facts: Gadi Eisenkot is confident of securing the mandate to form a government.
President Isaac Herzog will announce the candidate for government formation.
Eisenkot has received a commanding number of recommendations to replace Netanyahu.
